title: fix(tui): show billing service retry message on subscription step-up transport failures
claim: When billing.step_up cannot reach the gateway (rpc resolves null), the step-up must show the 'Could not reach the billing service ... retry' message, not the default admin-approval denial.

evidence.red: On main with only the new tests: 'step-up maps an unreachable gateway (rpc → null) to the retry message' fails: expected { error: undefined, granted: false, message: undefined } to deeply equal { granted: false, message: 'Could not reach the billing service — check your connection, then retry.' } (1 failed | 4 passed).
evidence.green: With the null branch in .then(): subscriptionCommand.test.ts 5/5 pass.
evidence.negative_control: Replacing only the null branch's message with undefined: the null test fails again (expected { granted:false, message: undefined } to deeply equal ...retry...).
evidence.adjacent: vitest: subscriptionCommand, subscriptionOverlay, billingStepUp, topupCommand = 4 files, 53 passed. ui-tui npm run typecheck clean; eslint + prettier --check clean.
evidence.source: main ui-tui/src/app/useMainApp.ts rpc(): try { ... } catch { sys(...) } return null (never rejects; GatewayRpc returns Promise<null|T>). subscription.ts requestRemoteSpending .then(r => ({error:r?.error, granted:!!(r&&r.ok&&r.granted), message:r?.message})).catch(...billingUnreachable) — catch unreachable. subscriptionOverlay.tsx stepUpDenialResult falls to T.notAllowed when error/message absent.

upstream_overlap: None found: gh search prs/issues for requestRemoteSpending, billingUnreachable, 'step-up billing service', 'Remote Spending transport'.
notes: Rebuilt on main (subscription.ts now uses i18n t(); the fork hard-coded the English string). Dropped the fork's subscriptionOverlay.test.tsx additions: they mock requestRemoteSpending directly and do not exercise the fix. Kanban baggage dropped. Sibling note (not changed): topup.ts requestRemoteSpending has the same dead .catch but null and reject both map to false there, so no user-visible bug. NOT_TESTED: live authenticated step-up with a real gateway drop. Commit dceade1de1.
